# Reserved words, generated from the patterns in scope. Do not edit.
#
# A word here may not appear in a name wherever its pattern is visible.
# Adding a line is a breaking change for every program that sees it.
#
# «Guillemets» mark text ABOUT the language rather than text in it — a hole
# with no declaration syntax yet, or a segment plain text cannot read back.
# Nothing inside them is source, and none of it can be copied into a program.

## RESERVED (0)


## RESERVES NOTHING (1) — every hole before a word is determinate

    «for each» «one word, or a bracketed name» in (_)

## PROTECTED (3) — no pattern may use these as glue

    old          builds old «a reactive name», and is refused in any segment, not only glue
    index        builds index of «a loop variable»
    of           builds index of «a loop variable»
